title: BREAK THE NIGHT'S STORYLINE
name: BREAK THE NIGHT'S STORYLINE
goal: Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.
steps:
1. Pick Word — Choose one harmless five-letter word, such as TABLE. Use each letter once; there is no need to finish perfectly.

4. Jump Letter — Jump to the next letter and a completely unrelated object. End after five letters; do not score sleep.
